verdict.rationale: The CLI documents an explicit `skills update [skills...]` command (with examples for updating all or specific skills) as well as symlink-based installs for 'easy updates' and a skills-lock.json restore path, giving developers a clear non-reinstall update mechanism. A community comment questions whether these tools document updates, but this is general skepticism rather than a concrete hands-on failure, so it doesn't rise to a dispute. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that `skills update` reliably applies fixes, and clarity on whether version-pinning/rollback is fully supported beyond the experimental lock-file restore.
